title: 040 · Stopping dispatch of a cancelled order
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Order control at Tallowmere Goods. From the case card: the merchant has authorised cancellation of DL-040 while the packed item is still in its warehouse, and warehouse stop confirmation is required before dispatch can be called cancelled.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: pass the authorised cancellation to the warehouse and get confirmation that dispatch is physically stopped.

order_control.name: Order control
order_control.responsibility: Provide the cancellation authority and ask for the warehouse dispatch stop.

warehouse.name: Warehouse dispatch
warehouse.responsibility: Physically remove DL-040 from outbound dispatch and report the resulting shipment status.

goal: Get the warehouse's confirmation that DL-040 has been physically removed from outbound dispatch under the authorised cancellation.
limits: Do not treat the dispatch stop as refund approval or payment.
Do not treat the dispatch stop as completed customer communication.

intake.summary: Stop warehouse dispatch of DL-040: the merchant has authorised cancellation, but the packed item is still in the warehouse.

steps.explanation: Order control wants the warehouse to stop DL-040 before the next outbound sweep, and the physical stop is not confirmed. We hold the cancellation authority from message 001, so we can instruct warehouse dispatch directly.
